title: O'Blood, Dirt and Cum
tagline: A mod that bridges Ocum, Dirt and Blood, and Skyrimnet... a bit more. :)
description:
A plugin that can go three ways.
O’Blood, Dirt and Cum is a small SkyrimNet companion that works with Dirt and Blood, OCum, or both. This plugin scans your system to see if you have one of the two mods installed or both. If you do, it does the following...


- Dirt and Blood only → SkyrimNet knows about your dirt and blood (and baths). Reports a little better than the stock prompt.
- OCum only → SkyrimNet knows when someone has cum on them. Reports a little more than the Ostimnet one does.
- Both → the above, plus a real Dirt and Blood bath actually washes the cum off (not just swimming or waiting for a timer).
- Followers and other NPCs actually walk into open waters to bathe instead of in the sand on the beach or in the road. (Custom player homes are hit or miss if tubs are present based on how the home is built.)
- Inventory safe with NPC reset after bathing. (See video in comments)

Nolvus Players Welcome.

“Why?”

> Because it’s not right when your lover finishes a bath and then talks to the innkeeper with stuff still hanging off their chin and everyone talking as if it's normal and they are clean.

changelog: > **0.3 → 0.5.7:** Baths now really wash cum off, overlays and Tull/Liquid/Beast Form meshes included, and SkyrimNet is only told someone is clean after that's checked. Leftover cum overlays on NPCs are cleared after the bath. NPCs can walk to nearby real water (lakes, rivers, pools, tubs) to bathe, and non-followers can WashUp too. New optional SkyrimNet customs make open-air or communal bathing, and intimacy at bathing spots, normal. Characters notice nearby water. There's a new troubleshooting log file and new MCM toggles. Save-safe, so just update in place. Custom player homes and rimmed tubs are hit an miss but open waters seem to always work, so no more having followers bathe in the road or in the sand on a beach. They actually go to the water first.
